name: User research plan
summary: When a design decision needs user evidence, the research lead gets one study plan: what the team needs to know, what evidence already exists, method options with their hours, participant criteria, permissions needed, how answers will be read and what the study cannot establish.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own design, written from its published map of design and user experience work: the design question, the user groups, the evidence already held, the constraints and the permissions, each in a fixed layout, matched to a fixed menu of study methods, with every gap written as a decision for the research lead and no finding stated.
